segments.text: Everyone sleeps on the Nexon — until they see what it does to cars twice its price.
Let's get down to business - this powerhouse boasts an 81 kW engine, and the best part? It's just getting started!
All that juice is packed into a sleek 1.5-litre engine - because who doesn't love a little efficiency with their speed?
And when you put the pedal to the metal, it'll take you from 0 to 100 in a mere 9.9 seconds - faster than you can say 'Tata Nexon' three times!

Now, the price estimate is around ₹7.37 lakh to ₹14.22 lakh - but let's be real, the sweet spot is the Creative variant, where you get all the bells and whistles: 360-degree camera, automatic climate control, alloy wheels, and cruise control. Yes, it's worth every penny!
Cruise control, 360-degree camera... who needs a significant other when you've got a Tata Nexon? Priorities, people!
